heads.la: I. Ad Richizam Romanorum imperatricem.--Consolatoria de morte Lotharii imperatoris et Henrici ducis Bavariae ejus generi.
heads.en: I. To Richenza, empress of the Romans.--A letter of consolation on the death of the emperor Lothar and of Henry, duke of Bavaria, her son-in-law. [n: (Anno 1139.)]
II. To the same.--On the same subject. [n: (Anno eod.)]

heads.la: III. Ad Conradum imperatorem II.--Congratulatur ei de sua in imperatorem electione, hortaturque ut strenue et christiane Romanum regat imperium, atque Casinense monasterium protegat.
heads.en: III. To the emperor Conrad II.--He congratulates him on his election as emperor, and exhorts him to rule the Roman empire vigorously and in a Christian manner, and to protect the monastery of Cassino. [n: (Anno eod.)]
